subject: maths
title: Fractions - One Half (½)
introductionText:
Term 3 · Fractions
Fractions — One Half (½)
The Big Idea: ½ means one of two equal parts. Two halves make one whole. Half of a
group is found by sharing it into two equal groups.
Say It Like This
Read aloud
"This is how we write one half: a 1 on top, a line, and a 2 underneath. The 2 tells us the
whole is cut into 2 equal parts. The 1 tells us we are talking about one of them. Put two
halves back together and you get one whole again. Half of 20 sweets? Share them onto
two plates: 10 each."
Watch Out For
The slip almost every child makes
Half of a big group is "2" because "half has a 2 in it". He says half of 20 is 2. Share real
objects — the plates show 10.
Writing ½ as "12" or "2/1". Say it as you write it: "one on top — line — two underneath."
Try It at Home
Game 1 — String halves (5 minutes)
Cut a piece of string or ribbon. Fold it so the two ends meet — the fold is exactly the
middle. Cut there. Lay the two pieces side by side: equal? Now try to find the middle of a
second string without folding. Which way worked better?
Game 2 — Halving pasta (10 minutes)
Count out 20 pieces of dry pasta. Share them onto two plates. Half of 20 is...? Now 16, 12,
18. Keep a list. Can you guess half of 14 before sharing?
1
the part we have
2
2 equal parts in the whole
½ is coloured
Point to the 1 and the 2 and say what each means. Then colour half of a paper plate together.
fold the ends together — the fold is the middle
Do this with a real piece of string before he answers the questions.
More examples to talk about
• Half of 20 is 10; half of 14 is 7; half of 18 is 9.
• Half an hour — you'll meet it on the clock in Unit 18.
• If half a team is 5 children, the whole team is 10.
• Tricky: half of a big pizza is more than half of a small pizza. Halves are equal only when
they come from the same whole.
• Tricky: half of 5 sweets means cutting one sweet in two.
Key Words
half ½ whole equal parts share fold fraction
